messages:
Priya: FYI customer can't redeem promo + free trial — auto-fraud block triggered. account_id=acct_9f3b, email=trialuser@mailinator.com, promo=PROMO23. Customer says they're a small startup and on a shared VPN. Error when applying promo: `trial_flagged: risk_score=0.86`. Can we review for manual override?

Liam: Can you paste the signup metadata (raw IP, UA, signup_ts) and whether there are any sibling accounts? Also any payment attempts?

Priya: Paste logs below:
```
signup_ts=1768004300
ip=45.33.22.11
ip_asn=ASN60140 (commercial vpn)
email=trialuser@mailinator.com
user_agent=curl/7.68.0
promo_apply_resp={"error":"trial_flagged","code":"RISK_DISPOSABLE_EMAIL|VPN_ASN"}
```
Only one account seen, no charges, no previous disputes. Ticket ZD#3242 has the customer notes. Customer requests immediate access — offering to share docs.

Nora: The risk engine matched two signals: disposable_email + vpn_asn. It escalated automatically. Risk engine id=risk-4b9; rule_set=v2.7. We can do a manual override but it requires an admin action and an audit entry. Steps: POST /internal/overrides {account_id, reason, grant_trial:true} with admin token. If we grant, we should also attach a verification note and set monitoring flags for 48h.

Liam: I'm going to do a quick manual verification: sent verification email and scheduled a 10m video call. If they provide incorporation or ID and live on call, approve. Will note decision. :mag_right:

Priya: Update — customer verified via 1:1 video at 14:30, provided incorporation doc (screenshot) and said they were using a company VPN. No evidence of prior abuse. They are genuine. Ready for override if T&S approves.

Liam: Good. Approve manual grant. Nora, please perform override and attach audit note: "Verified via video; corp docs provided; low risk after review." Also apply PROMO23 to acct_9f3b and enable 14-day trial.

Nora: Executing override now. Command run: 
```
POST https://internal.redwood/api/v1/overrides
Authorization: Bearer <ADMIN_TOKEN>
{
  "account_id":"acct_9f3b",
  "grant_trial":true,
  "trial_days":14,
  "promo_code":"PROMO23",
  "note":"Verified via video call + incorporation docs. Temporary override. Monitor 48h."
}
```

Sam (audit-bot): Override recorded: ov-9981 by Nora at 1768004955. Audit log: https://internal.redwood/audits/ov-9981

Nora: Promo applied and trial granted. Added monitoring hook: route traffic to enhanced telemetry for 48h, alerts on abnormal token usage and rapid API key rotation.

Priya: Thanks team — closing loop with customer now and will cc eng-oncall for the monitoring window. :white_check_mark:
